Audio sample format.

Wraps Symphonia's `SampleFormat`. Describes how decoded audio samples
are represented in memory.

Only needed for raw PCM data where the format cannot be inferred
from the container.

## Rerun datatype
[`SampleFormat`](../datatypes/sample_format.md)


## Arrow datatype
```
uint8
```
